observations.body: Signs, gathering, public regard, crowds, illness, and hopes surrounding Peter’s passing shadow are reported together.
observations.label: Peter’s shadow

observations.body: The passage presents Gathering and bringing the sick as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Gathering and bringing the sick

observations.body: The passage places Peter beside Gathering and bringing the sick.
observations.label: Peter

payload.posture: Read Acts 5:12–16 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states signs, gathering, public regard, crowds, illness, and hopes surrounding Peter’s passing shadow are reported together. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
